event.name: GUBCPC Intra University Programming Contest 2026
event.venue: Green University of Bangladesh, Purbachal Campus
event.description: GUBCPC hosts its annual Intra University Programming Contest, bringing together the brightest minds from Green University of Bangladesh. Compete, collaborate, and conquer algorithmic challenges in this prestigious programming event.

about.description: GUB Competitive Programming Community (GUBCPC) is the premier programming club of Green University of Bangladesh. Founded with the mission to foster algorithmic thinking and competitive programming culture among students, we have been nurturing talent since our inception.
about.mission: To create a thriving competitive programming culture at Green University of Bangladesh by providing resources, mentorship, and opportunities for students to excel in algorithmic problem solving.
about.vision: To be recognized as one of the leading competitive programming communities in Bangladesh, producing top-tier programmers who compete at national and international levels.

events.title: Registration Opens
events.desc: Participant check-in and team registration at the main auditorium entrance.

events.title: Orientation Session
events.desc: Welcome speech by the faculty advisor and club president. Contest rules briefing.

events.title: Practice Contest
events.desc: A 1-hour mock contest to familiarize participants with the judging system (DOMjudge).

events.title: Networking Session
events.desc: Meet fellow programmers, mentors, and alumni over refreshments.

events.title: Participants Arrival
events.desc: All contestants report to the contest hall. System check and setup.

events.title: Contest Begins
events.desc: The official 5-hour programming contest starts. 10–12 algorithmic problems await.

events.title: Contest Ends
events.desc: All submissions frozen. Final standings calculated.

events.title: Lunch Break
events.desc: Lunch for all participants and guests.

events.title: Award Ceremony
events.desc: Prize distribution, certificates, and closing remarks. Top 3 teams receive trophies and cash prizes.

contact.address: Green University of Bangladesh, 220/D, Begum Rokeya Sarani, Purbachal, Dhaka-1207
